story.title: Lost First, Bow First
story.text: Yue lost, so Gou Jian bowed to Wu and sent someone to learn what Fu Chai liked.
story.narration: Yue and Wu went to war, and Yue lost. King Gou Jian did not push back head-on. He sent Fan Li to find out one thing: what did King Fu Chai of Wu really care about? The tale is told in the Wu Yue Chun Qiu, written down long after the events and often questioned, yet the lesson holds: to reach someone, first learn what he wants.

story.title: Find Out What He Cares About
story.text: A horse, silk and a sword lay ready. Fu Chai's eyes kept coming back to one.
story.narration: Yue prepared three fine things: a horse, a bolt of silk and a sword. Which one should they send? Gou Jian watched Fu Chai's eyes. The horse and the sword he glanced at, then looked away; only the silk drew his gaze back, and held it longest. Send that one, and you send it to his heart.

keyMoment.question: Three fine gifts lie before the hall. How do you know which one to send?

options.text: Watch which one he keeps looking at, then send that one
Send all three, so one of them is sure to please him
options.hint: He gets a pile and still does not care - plenty is not the same as right.

options.text: Send the one that looks the most costly
options.hint: Costly is our idea; what he cares about shows in his eyes.

keyMoment.reveal: First find out what he cares about, then give that one - right beats plenty.

misconceptions: The Beauty Trap is just giving someone pretty things
The more you give the better; pick the costly one

quiz.question: Yue had a horse, silk and a sword. How could they know which to send?
options: Watch where Fu Chai's eyes kept resting
quiz.explanation: What he wants is written in his eyes - watching where his gaze rests tells you more than asking.

quiz.question: Your class wants a welcome gift for a new classmate. What is the better way to choose?
options: Notice what he plays with and looks at, then prepare that
Buy the most expensive thing in the shop
Buy one of everything and let him choose
quiz.explanation: Find out what he cares about, then give that one - that is the practical step in the Beauty Trap.

gifts.speak: A horse from Yue: it runs like the wind.
A bolt of fine silk, light and soft.
A sword from Yue, its blade shining.

levelScript.refuseLine: Fu Chai waves it away: leave that one for now.
